signals_info.description: Whether the valid traffic light associated with the current path is red.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some future time, the condition traffic_light_red == 1 shall cease to be true.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在未来某个时刻，traffic_light_red == 1 这一条件应刚停止成立。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The traffic signal governing the vehicle's path shall cease showing red at some future time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 控制车辆当前行驶路径的交通信号应在未来某个时刻结束红灯状态。
